title: Are Social Sentiments Inherent in LLMs? An Empirical Study on Extraction of Inter-demographic Sentiments
findings: The study found that for religious groups, sentiments extracted from LLMs showed a positive correlation with social survey data, indicating an alignment with real-world sentiments. More than half of the test combinations showed correlations of 0.3 or higher. However, the correlation coefficients were generally lower and the results more variable (higher p-values) compared to the findings for nationalities.
